About Me

I am Pavithra N, a final-year Electronics and Communication Engineering student at Adhiparasakthi Engineering College. I have developed foundational knowledge in electronics, embedded systems, Verilog, VLSI, microcontrollers, communication protocols, and programming.

I enjoy working on practical engineering projects involving embedded systems, IoT, robotics, automotive electronics, and digital design. Through academic projects, internships, hackathons, and technical training, I have developed an interest in solving real-world engineering problems.

I also value communication, teamwork, leadership, coordination, and continuous learning.
